title: Apartment listing
text_content: Downtown listing: one-bedroom apartment. Rent is $1,500 a month. Utilities are extra. There is a kitchen and a small bedroom. Available June 1. Deposit is one month of rent. Email an inquiry to the landlord for a Saturday viewing. A roommate is okay. Bring photo ID. Send notice if you cannot come. The lease is twelve months.

questions.question: Utilities are included in the rent.
The deposit is one month of ____.
questions.explanation: Deposit is one month of rent.

cultural_note: Canadian listings often say whether utilities are included. First and last month's rent is common.

title: Lease clause
text_content: This lease is for the downtown apartment. The tenant pays rent on the first day. There is a bedroom and a kitchen. The landlord can enter with 24-hour notice. A roommate needs written approval. Keep the deposit until you move out. Send an inquiry in writing. The listing address is on page one. A viewing does not mean the apartment is yours until you sign.

questions.question: When is rent due?
questions.explanation: Rent is on the first day.

questions.question: The landlord can enter with no notice.

cultural_note: Ontario leases usually require notice before a landlord enters.
